title: The Man Who Was Born Blind
reflectionQuestion: Have you ever had to explain something you barely understood yourself, to people who did not want to believe?
reflectionText: He was born into darkness, and it was the only world he knew. A stranger knelt beside him, put mud on his eyes, and told him to wash. What changed was not his effort — he found no cure. And when the questions came afterward, and the people who would not believe, and the moment they threw him out, Jesus came and found him. What is it to see most clearly with the least reason — and to still believe?

scriptureKeyVerse.text: He therefore answered, “I don’t know if he is a sinner. One thing I do know: that though I was blind, now I see.”
